detailedIncidentDescription: A near-miss occurred near the equipment staging area when a piece of material shifted unexpectedly while being repositioned. No injuries were reported and no equipment was damaged during the shift itself, though a nearby hose coupling was later found cracked during the post-incident walk-through.

witnesses.name: Kris Taute
witnesses.statement: I saw the material shift while it was being repositioned. Nobody was in the immediate area and no one was hurt.

natureOfDamage: Coupling cracked when dropped during the incident
selectedCauses: unsafeActs::Improper type PPE or use of it
managementDeficienciesOther: Site-specific staging procedure not documented for this work area
supervisorNotes:
Area has been flagged for review. Toolbox talk held with crew on proper material staging and securing before repositioning.

- Reinforce spotter requirement
- Inspect staging area weekly
- Re-brief crew on housekeeping standards
safetyConsultantNotes: Recommend adding a documented staging procedure for this yard and a weekly housekeeping inspection. Coupling failure appears unrelated to the near-miss itself but should be tracked separately as a maintenance item. Suggest reviewing similar yards for the same gap before the next audit cycle. No further investigation action needed beyond the above -- this can close out once the staging procedure is published.
